description: Poly Volume: Polymarket activity screen — ranks markets by turnover (24h volume divided by resting liquidity) and reports the round-trip cost, so you can tell a market that is genuinely busy from one that is merely large. Filter with minVolumeUsd and maxSpreadBps to get only markets worth trading. Use x402-poly-markets for a plain list; use this when the question is "where is there real activity I can actually participate in".
name: x402-poly-volume
